# Copilot

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). It is the contract for this repository.

`.ai/` is not injected automatically. Before editing, read [.ai/rules/index.md](../.ai/rules/index.md) and the rule whose paths match the files you change. Review workflows are `.ai/skills/frontend-review/SKILL.md` and `.ai/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`.

Do not push, merge to `main`, or start the Deploy workflow unless the user asks in the current request.
